zh_CN.connectingHint: 正在连接社区账号与云端功德。
zh_CN.instruction: 轻敲木鱼，留住片刻平静
zh_CN.storageHint: 功德与祈福跟随社区账号保存在云端。换设备登录同一账号即可继续使用。
zh_CN.resetHint: 累计功德与今日功德都会归零，此操作无法撤销。
zh_CN.storageCorrupt: 旧记录无法读取，已建立新的功德记录
zh_CN.storageUnavailable: 当前环境无法持久保存，功德会保留到本页关闭
zh_CN.audioUnavailable: 声音暂不可用，功德仍会正常累计
zh_CN.fullscreenUnavailable: 当前环境无法进入全屏
zh_CN.communityError: 社区能力连接失败，已切换为本页模式
zh_CN.imageError: 木鱼图片加载失败，点击原位置仍可敲击
zh_CN.wishPlaceholder: 愿平安顺遂，所求皆如愿
zh_CN.wishPrivacy: 仅自己可见，不会发表到社区
zh_CN.wishStartHint: 从祈福开始后，每敲一下，进度加一。
zh_CN.wishActiveHint: 完成这一愿后，就可以开始新的祈福。
zh_CN.wishCompleteHint: 这一份心愿已经完成，愿所求皆如愿。
zh_CN.wishSealing: 余音凝定，正将此愿封存云端…
zh_CN.wishCreateFailed: 祈福未能保存，请稍后重试
zh_CN.loginRequiredMessage: 功德与祈福将跟随社区账号保存在云端，请先在社区登录，再点击重新连接。
zh_CN.permissionMessage: 请允许读取当前账号、保存同步缓存及连接木鱼服务，然后重试。
zh_CN.offlineMessage: 尚未同步的功德已安全保留。恢复网络后点击重新连接，不会重复累计。
zh_CN.cacheErrorMessage: 为避免覆盖尚未同步的功德，本次没有开放敲击。请刷新或稍后重试。
zh_CN.serviceTitle: 木鱼服务暂未接受请求
zh_CN.serviceMessage: 服务端暂时拒绝了本次请求，功德未改动。请稍后重试；若刚更新应用，请检查 Worker 环境与应用版本是否一致，无需重新授权账号权限。

en.connectingHint: Connecting your community account and cloud merit.
en.instruction: A gentle tap, a quiet moment
en.localOnly: Merit is saved in this browser
en.hitAria: Tap the wooden fish to gain one merit
en.soundHint: A gentle response to every tap
en.storageHint: Merit and wishes are stored with your community account. Sign in with the same account on another device to continue.
en.resetHint: Both total and today's merit will be cleared. This cannot be undone.
en.storageCorrupt: The old record was unreadable, so a new one was created
en.storageUnavailable: Saving is unavailable. Merit will remain until this page closes
en.audioUnavailable: Sound is unavailable, but merit still counts
en.communityError: Community features are unavailable; continuing in page-only mode
en.imageError: The image could not load, but you can still tap its area
en.wishPlaceholder: For peace, clarity and good things ahead
en.wishPrivacy: Only visible to you; never posted to the community
en.wishStartHint: Every tap after this point advances your wish by one.
en.wishActiveHint: Complete this wish before beginning another.
en.wishCompleteHint: Your dedication is complete. May good things come your way.
en.wishCreateFailed: The wish could not be saved. Please try again
en.loginRequiredMessage: Merit and wishes are stored with your community account. Sign in to the community, then reconnect.
en.permissionMessage: Allow account information, local sync storage and access to the Muyu service, then retry.
en.offlineMessage: Unsynced merit is preserved. Reconnect when your network is available; retries are never counted twice.
en.cacheErrorMessage: Counting is paused to protect unsynced merit. Refresh or try again later.
en.serviceTitle: The service did not accept this request
en.serviceMessage: Your merit is unchanged. If you just updated the app, make sure the Worker environment and app version match before retrying. No additional account authorization is needed.
